text:
maya: Quick design question — we have a few requests about the chart unit toggle (pct vs absolute) and where to surface the smoothing control on the console. Thoughts?
rohan: I keep getting asked by PMs for an obvious unit switch next to the metric name. they expect %/raw toggle inline, not buried in settings.
maya: Agreed. Current placement in the collapsed header is too hidden. What about a small pill to the right of the axis label: "Units: % / raw"?
kevin: That works visually but keyboard/aria needs to be considered. If it’s a pill, we should expose it as a segmented control with proper roles.
a11y-bot: Suggestion: segmented control with role="tablist" and each option role="tab" + aria-pressed states. Also label: "Toggle units".
maya: Nice. Copy question: do we label options as "% (relative)" and "raw (absolute)" or just "%" and "units"?
rohan: Short is better. use just "%" and "value". add a tooltip: "Show values as percent of baseline" on hover.
kevin: +1. For tooltip copy keep it terse. Also think about persistence — should the unit toggle be global per-dashboard or per-chart?
maya: PM says per-chart but remember DevEx wants a dashboard-level override. Maybe both: per-chart default with dashboard override in the header.
rohan: Implementation note: if dashboard override is set, show a subtle badge on charts: "Using dashboard units" that links to header. keeps consistency.
kevin: Another thing: smoothing. Folks can't find the smooth toggle on small multiples. Where do we expose it?
maya: Options: (1) tiny icon on series legend, (2) global smoothing switch in chart toolbar, (3) per-series context menu.
rohan: Per-series is nice but adds complexity. toolbar would be discoverable and consistent for quick toggles. legend icon is quickest to toggle single series.
a11y-bot: Make sure icon-only controls have accessible name and keyboard focus. e.g., <button aria-label="Toggle smoothing for series X">Smooth</button>.
maya: UI copy experiment for toolbar: "Smoothing: Off/Light/Heavy" — three states. But product is worried about complexity. maybe Off / On with a second step for intensity in the series menu.
kevin: I'd prefer Off / On for the toolbar and a nested intensity slider in series settings. keeps toolbar clean.
rohan: Outlier handling: Ops team prefers automated capping, but design wants the raw point to remain drillable. can we visually cap but expose a toggle to "Show raw spikes"?
maya: Proposal: visually clamp to 95th percentile for display, show a faint caret/chevron where points were clipped. clicking caret opens contextual panel with raw points and a single-line explanation: "Values above 95th percentile clipped for clarity. Show raw values."
a11y-bot: Caret should be reachable via keyboard and have aria-expanded on open. Provide alternative text: "Some points clipped — press to reveal raw values".
kevin: Also add a small microcopy under chart: "Clipped values are shown at the top of the chart; click to view raw" — small 12px body.
rohan: Regarding legend interactions: folks requested quick keyboard toggles to hide/show series. we should support Space/Enter on focused legend rows to toggle visibility and add aria-checked states.
maya: Good call. Also add a tiny focus ring for keyboard nav in dark mode (current ring is nearly invisible).
kevin: About tests: Dev/QA — we need a short acceptance checklist: 1) unit toggle visible and keyboard operable; 2) smoothing toggle accessible from toolbar; 3) clipping caret appears when applicable and reveals raw values; 4) legend toggles via keyboard; 5) microcopy matches approved strings.
rohan: I'll add those to the ticket. Maya, can you paste final copy suggestions?
maya: Sure — draft copies: 
- Unit toggle options: "%" and "value"
- Unit tooltip: "Show values relative to baseline (percent)"
- Smoothing toolbar label: "Smoothing: Off" / "Smoothing: On"
- Clipping caret alt: "Points clipped above 95th percentile. Press to view raw."
- Clipping microcopy: "Some spikes clipped for readability — click to view raw values."

kevin: Looks good. tiny nit: change "baseline" to "selected baseline" in the tooltip to be explicit.
maya: Updated: "Show values relative to selected baseline (percent)"
rohan: I'll wire this up with the product ticket and tag eng. thanks all! :rockets: 
kevin: One more: add a dev note for telemetry — track when users toggle smoothing intensity and when they expand clipped values so we can measure usefulness.
maya: noted. will include event names in the ticket.
a11y-bot: final reminder: ensure color contrast of the pill and tooltip meets AA (4.5:1) in both themes.
rohan: Will check with dev. Closing thread — ping if anything else. :thumbsup:
